idiomatic: Sheng bribed his nobles, learned where Qin was, seized him in a night raid, and showed him to Yonglu.

idiomatic: If he now obtains an imperial princess and borrows her authority, Dianjue and Ran'gan will again suffer his summons to war.

idiomatic: Moreover Ran'gan is the son of Chuluohou and has long shown sincere loyalty through two reigns now.

idiomatic: An edict mobilized six grand marshals, all under Prince of Han's command, to march out by separate routes beyond the border and attack.

idiomatic: Yonglu was afraid and again allied with Datou; together they launched a surprise attack on Ran'gan and fought a great battle below the Long Wall.

idiomatic: Ran'gan was defeated; his brothers, sons, and nephews were all killed, and his tribes scattered and fled.

idiomatic: By dawn they had gone more than a hundred li and gathered several hundred riders.

idiomatic: They then plotted together, saying:

idiomatic: "Now, defeated in battle, if we enter court we are but surrendered men—will the Son of Heaven of Great Sui treat us with ceremony!

idiomatic: Dianjue may come, but originally we had no grievance; if we go to him, he will surely preserve us."

idiomatic: "The beacons on the wall are burning—what is it?"

idiomatic: if many come, three beacons;

literal: This makes them see that the enemy are many and near."

idiomatic: "Pursuing troops are already pressing—let us take refuge in the city for now."

idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased and advanced Sheng to General of Agile Cavalry of the Left Merit Guard, with credentials as commissioner protecting the Türks.

idiomatic: The sky dog fell; blood rained three days;

idiomatic: a shooting star fell within his camp with a sound like thunder.

idiomatic: Each night he startled himself, saying Sui troops were about to arrive.

idiomatic: He sent memorials reporting all of this.

idiomatic: Before long Ran'gan was made Qaghan Yimidou Qiren.

idiomatic: An archery contest was granted in the Hall of Martial Peace; twelve skilled archers were chosen and divided into two sides.

literal: The Qiren said:
idiomatic: The Qiren said:

idiomatic: "Your servant, through Grandee Changsun, came to see the Son of Heaven; today, granted this shooting match, I wish to join his side."

literal: It was granted.
idiomatic: It was granted.

idiomatic: Arrows were supplied; six shots all struck the deer, and the Qiren's side won in the end.

idiomatic: At that time a flock of kites was flying; the emperor said:

idiomatic: "You are skilled with the sling—fetch them for me."

idiomatic: Ten shots all hit; each answered the pellet and fell.

idiomatic: That day the hundred officials received gifts, but Sheng alone received the most.

idiomatic: Soon he was sent to lead fifty thousand men to build Dali City at Shuozhou to house Ran'gan.

idiomatic: When Princess of Anyi died, he was sent with credentials to escort Princess of Yicheng and again give her in marriage.

idiomatic: Sheng again memorialized:

idiomatic: "Ran'gan's tribes who have submitted are already numerous; though within the Long Wall, they are still raided by Yonglu.

literal: Coming and going in hardship, they cannot live in peace.
idiomatic: Coming and going in hardship, they cannot live in peace.

idiomatic: I ask that they be moved to Wuyuan, with the river as a bulwark.

idiomatic: Between Xia and Sheng provinces, east and west to the river and four hundred li north and south, dig a transverse trench.

idiomatic: Let them dwell within, grazing as they please, free from raids—the people will surely settle themselves.

idiomatic: The emperor followed it all.

idiomatic: In the twentieth year Dulan fell into great disorder and was killed by his subordinates.

literal: Sheng therefore memorialized:
idiomatic: Sheng therefore memorialized:

literal: Seize this moment to entice them—they will surely all come to surrender.
idiomatic: Seize this moment to entice them—they will surely all come to surrender.

literal: Please send Ran'gan's subordinates in separate parties to summon and comfort them."
idiomatic: Please send Ran'gan's subordinates in separate parties to summon and comfort them."

idiomatic: The emperor assented, and in the end they all came to submit.

idiomatic: Datou was terrified and again gathered a great army.

idiomatic: An edict ordered Sheng to command the surrendered men as grand marshal on campaign for Qinzhou, under Prince of Jin Guang's command, to march out and attack Datou.

idiomatic: Datou opposed the prince; Sheng advanced a stratagem:

idiomatic: "The Türks drink from springs—poison is easily applied."

idiomatic: He therefore took various drugs and poisoned the upstream water.

idiomatic: "The general in wrath makes his might walk beyond the borders—even thunder is his measure. How splendid!"

idiomatic: I have carefully checked the military manuals—this is called 'spilled blood.'

idiomatic: An edict made Yang Su grand marshal on campaign; Sheng was made envoy receiving surrender and escorted Ran'gan on a northern campaign.
